facts.text: I am trying to stay organized with my cleaning routine.
I want help creating a schedule to track my daily and weekly cleaning tasks.
I take out the trash and recycling on a specific day of the week.
I wipe down the kitchen counters and sink after dinner.
I want to replace the daily task of wiping down kitchen counters and sink after breakfast with another task.
I put away clean laundry as soon as it comes out of the dryer.
I do laundry every Sunday morning.
I want to know whether I should include laundry every Sunday morning as a weekly task in my schedule.
I am establishing a habit of putting away my shoes in the closet instead of leaving them by the front door.
I want tips to make putting away my shoes a consistent habit.
I will link putting away my shoes to taking off my shoes to make it automatic.
I will place a small reminder note near the front door to help me remember to put away my shoes.

keyphrases: trash and recycling day of week
wipe down kitchen counters and sink
